topics.title: Small talk без ступору
topics.goal: почати, підтримати й природно завершити коротку розмову

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, is this your first time here?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. I came with a colleague.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Nice! What do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: I design mobile apps.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. How did you get into that?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: I started as a graphic designer.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great talking to you. Shall we stay in touch?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me add you on LinkedIn.

alternatives: Hi, how's your day?
Hi, how are you doing today?

phrases.en: Is this your first time here?
How do you know the host?

alternatives: What kind of work do you do?
What do you do for work?

phrases.en: What are you working on these days?
How did you get into that?
It was great talking to you.
alternatives: It was nice talking to you.
I enjoyed our conversation.

topics.title: Аеропорт і паспортний контроль
topics.goal: пройти реєстрацію, контроль і знайти потрібний вихід

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Good morning. Where are you flying today?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: To London. I'd like to check in for my flight.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Do you have any bags to check?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: One suitcase. Is the flight on time?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Yes. Boarding starts at 10:20 at gate 14.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Where is security control?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Straight ahead, then turn left.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks for your help.

phrases.en: I'd like to check in for my flight.
Can I see your passport, please?
Do I need to check this bag?
phrases.uk: Чи треба здавати цю сумку в багаж?

alternatives: Where is security?
How do I get to security?

phrases.en: Which gate does the flight leave from?

alternatives: I'm catching a connecting flight.
I have a connection.

phrases.en: Where can I collect my luggage?

alternatives: My luggage is missing.
I can't find my suitcase.

phrases.en: I'll be staying for ten days.

topics.title: Кафе й ресторан
topics.goal: замовити, уточнити склад, розв'язати проблему й оплатити

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: Hi. Are you ready to order?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Almost. What do you recommend?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: The grilled salmon is very popular.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Does it contain dairy?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: The sauce does, but we can serve it separately.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll have that, please.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.text: Anything to drink?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Still water, please.

alternatives: I'll have the chicken, please.
Can I get the chicken, please?

phrases.en: Can I have it without onions?

phrases.uk: У мене алергія на молочні продукти.
Це не те, що я замовляв/замовляла.
alternatives: I ordered something else.
I ordered a different dish.

phrases.en: Could we have the bill, please?
alternatives: Can we get the bill, please?
The check, please.

topics.title: Готель
topics.goal: заселитися, уточнити умови й домогтися вирішення проблеми

dialogue.speaker: Reception
dialogue.text: Welcome. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I have a reservation under Kovalenko.

dialogue.speaker: Reception
dialogue.text: Yes, a double room for three nights.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's right. Is breakfast included?

dialogue.speaker: Reception
dialogue.text: Yes, from 7 to 10 downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Could I have the Wi-Fi password?

dialogue.speaker: Reception
dialogue.text: It's on your key-card holder.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you.

phrases.en: I have a reservation under Kovalenko.
phrases.uk: У мене бронювання на прізвище Коваленко.
alternatives: The booking is under Kovalenko.
I booked a room under Kovalenko.

phrases.en: Could I have the Wi-Fi password?

phrases.uk: Можете залишити мій багаж на зберігання?

alternatives: It's very noisy in my room.
The noise in the room is a problem.
Could I move to another room?
Is another room available?

phrases.en: Could you call me a taxi?

topics.title: Співбесіда
topics.goal: чітко представити досвід, сильні сторони й поставити запитання

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Tell me about yourself.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'm a project coordinator with three years of experience in education.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: What result are you most proud of?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I redesigned our onboarding and reduced support requests by 25%.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Why are you interested in this role?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It combines customer work with process improvement.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Any questions for us?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. What would success look like in the first three months?

phrases.en: I've worked in this field for three years.
phrases.uk: Я працюю в цій сфері три роки.
alternatives: I have three years of experience in this field.
I've been in this field for three years.

phrases.en: One result I'm proud of is...
alternatives: One achievement I'm proud of is...
A result I'm particularly proud of is...

phrases.en: My strength is turning ideas into action.
phrases.uk: Моя сильна сторона — перетворювати ідеї на дії.

phrases.en: I work well both independently and in a team.
phrases.uk: Я добре працюю і самостійно, і в команді.

phrases.en: I'm interested in this role because...
phrases.uk: Мене цікавить ця роль, тому що...

phrases.en: What would success look like in this role?
phrases.uk: Як виглядає успіх у цій ролі?

alternatives: What happens next?
Could you tell me about the next stage?

topics.title: Робота й зустрічі
topics.goal: висловити думку, уточнити, не погодитися та зафіксувати рішення

dialogue.speaker: Lead
dialogue.text: Could you give us an update?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: The draft is ready, but we're waiting for legal review.

dialogue.speaker: Lead
dialogue.text: What's the impact on the timeline?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My concern is that we may miss Friday's deadline.

dialogue.speaker: Lead
dialogue.text: Could we release the first part now?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. I can prepare it by Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: Lead
dialogue.text: Great. Who will notify the client?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'll do it and send a summary today.

phrases.en: The goal of today's meeting is...
Could you walk us through it?

alternatives: If I've understood correctly...
So, if I'm following you correctly...

phrases.en: I agree with the main point.

alternatives: I have a different view.
I look at it a little differently.

phrases.en: Can we make a decision today?
Who will take ownership of this?
I'll send a summary after the meeting.

alternatives: Let's come back to this next week.
We can discuss this again next week.

topics.title: Телефон і відеодзвінки
topics.goal: почати дзвінок, упоратися зі зв'язком і домовитися про дію

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, this is Olena from SpeakChain. Is now still a good time?

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.text: Yes, but I only have ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No problem. I'm calling about Friday's workshop.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.text: Sorry, your sound is breaking up.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks for telling me. Is this better?

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.text: Yes, much better.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Let me confirm the start time: 3 p.m.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.text: Correct. Please follow up by email.

phrases.en: Hi, this is Olena from SpeakChain.
Is now still a good time?
alternatives: Is this still a good time to talk?
Do you have a moment to talk?
The audio keeps cutting out.
I can't hear you clearly.
I'll send you an email afterwards.
I'll confirm everything by email.

topics.title: Лікар і аптека
topics.goal: описати симптоми, зрозуміти рекомендації й безпечно уточнити ліки

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: What seems to be the problem?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I've had a fever and a sore throat for two days.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Any difficulty breathing?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, but it hurts when I swallow.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Are you allergic to any medication?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: I'll prescribe something else.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How often should I take it?

phrases.en: I'd like to make an appointment.
I've had a fever for two days.
alternatives: I've had a temperature for two days.
My fever started two days ago.

phrases.en: I have a sharp pain here.

alternatives: The pain is becoming more severe.
It hurts more than before.

phrases.en: How often should I take it?
alternatives: How many times a day should I take it?
When should I take this medicine?

topics.title: Покупки, оплата й повернення
topics.goal: знайти товар, приміряти, оплатити або повернути без конфлікту

dialogue.speaker: Assistant
dialogue.text: Can I help you find anything?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do you have this jacket in a medium?

dialogue.speaker: Assistant
dialogue.text: Let me check. Yes, here you are.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. Can I try it on?

dialogue.speaker: Assistant
dialogue.text: Of course. The fitting rooms are over there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It fits. Is there a discount on this?

dialogue.speaker: Assistant
dialogue.text: Yes, it's 20% off today.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll take it.

alternatives: I'm only browsing, thank you.
I'm just having a look.

phrases.en: Do you have this in a smaller size?
Is there a discount on this?

alternatives: It's the wrong size.
The fit isn't right.
Can I have my money back?
Could you refund this, please?

topics.title: Транспорт, таксі й дорога
topics.goal: знайти маршрут, купити квиток і пояснити водієві, куди їхати

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, which bus goes to the station?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: Take the 24 from the stop across the road.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do I need to change?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: No, it's direct. Get off after the museum.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How long will it take?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: About twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Where can I buy a ticket?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.text: You can tap your card on the bus.

phrases.en: How do I get to the city centre?
alternatives: What's the best way to get to the city centre?
Could you tell me how to reach the city centre?

phrases.en: Which bus goes to the station?
Where can I buy a ticket?
Does this train stop at Oxford?
Where do I need to change?
alternatives: Where should I transfer?
Which station do I change at?

phrases.en: I'd like to go to this address.
phrases.uk: Я хочу доїхати за цією адресою.

phrases.en: Could you drop me off here?
alternatives: Could you let me out here?
This is fine, thank you.

phrases.en: Could you use the meter, please?
I think we've gone the wrong way.

topics.title: Оренда житла й побутові проблеми
topics.goal: поставити правильні питання до оренди та домогтися ремонту

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: What would you like to know?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Are bills included in the rent?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Water is included, but electricity and heating are separate.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How much is the deposit?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: One month's rent.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Could I see the contract before I decide?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll email it today.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. When is the earliest move-in date?

alternatives: Does the rent include utilities?
Are utilities included in the rent?

phrases.en: Could I see the contract first?

alternatives: The heating doesn't work.
There's a problem with the heating.

phrases.en: There's a leak under the sink.

alternatives: When can somebody come and fix it?
How soon can this be repaired?

phrases.en: Could you confirm this in writing?

topics.title: Екстрені ситуації, поліція й загублені речі
topics.goal: швидко повідомити хто ви, де ви, що сталося і яка допомога потрібна

dialogue.speaker: Operator
dialogue.text: Emergency. Which service do you need?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: An ambulance, please. There's been an accident.

dialogue.speaker: Operator
dialogue.text: What's your exact location?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: We're outside 24 King Street, near the pharmacy.

dialogue.speaker: Operator
dialogue.text: Is anyone injured?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, one person is bleeding but conscious.

dialogue.speaker: Operator
dialogue.text: Help is on the way. Stay on the line.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll stay here.

alternatives: I need assistance.
Can someone help me, please?
Someone stole my phone.
I've had my phone stolen.

phrases.en: I'd like to report a theft.
Can I have the report number?

alternatives: Could I have an interpreter?
I need someone who speaks Ukrainian.

topics.title: Банк і фінанси
topics.goal: відкрити рахунок, уточнити комісії та швидко відреагувати на підозрілу операцію

dialogue.speaker: Adviser
dialogue.text: Good morning. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'd like to open an account.

dialogue.speaker: Adviser
dialogue.text: Of course. May I see your ID and proof of address?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Certainly. Are there any monthly fees?

dialogue.speaker: Adviser
dialogue.text: No, but you need to keep a minimum balance of fifty pounds.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I see. Could I have a debit card as well?

dialogue.speaker: Adviser
dialogue.text: Yes. It will arrive within five working days.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. How do I activate online banking?

phrases.en: I'd like to open an account.
alternatives: I'd like to set up a bank account.
I want to open a new account.

phrases.en: Could I have a debit card?
How do I activate online banking?

alternatives: I don't know what this payment is.
This transaction wasn't made by me.

phrases.en: Could you freeze the card, please?
alternatives: Could you block the card, please?
Please put an immediate freeze on the card.

phrases.en: When will the money be refunded?
Could you explain the exchange rate?
Could I get this in writing?

topics.title: Державні установи й документи
topics.goal: записатися, подати документи та отримати чітке підтвердження наступного кроку

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Good morning. What can I help you with?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'd like to apply for a residence document.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Have you completed the online form?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. Which documents are required?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Your passport, proof of address and one photograph.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do you need the originals or copies?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Please bring the originals. We'll make copies here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will the process take?

phrases.en: I'd like to make an appointment.
Could you help me fill this in?

alternatives: What documents do I need?
Which documents should I bring?

phrases.en: Do you need the original or a copy?
Does this document need to be translated?
How long will the process take?
alternatives: How long does the process usually take?
When should I expect a decision?

phrases.en: Can I track my application online?

alternatives: Could you confirm that in writing?
Can you send me a confirmation email?

phrases.en: Who should I contact if there is a problem?
phrases.uk: До кого звернутися, якщо виникне проблема?

topics.title: Школа й дитячий садок
topics.goal: записати дитину, повідомити важливі потреби та обговорити навчання з учителем

dialogue.speaker: Administrator
dialogue.text: Hello. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'd like to enrol my child for next term.

dialogue.speaker: Administrator
dialogue.text: Certainly. How old is your child?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: She's seven. Which documents are required?

dialogue.speaker: Administrator
dialogue.text: Her passport, birth certificate and proof of address.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. She's still learning English. Is language support available?

dialogue.speaker: Administrator
dialogue.text: Yes, she'll have two support sessions each week.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's helpful. Could you send me the timetable by email?

phrases.en: I'd like to enrol my child.
alternatives: I'd like to register my child.
I want to apply for a school place for my child.

phrases.en: When does the school day start?
My child has a food allergy.
My child is still learning English.
alternatives: My child is learning English as an additional language.
My child's English is still developing.

phrases.en: How can I report an absence?

alternatives: Could we talk about how they're doing?
Could we arrange a progress meeting?

phrases.en: Is there anything we should practise at home?
Could you send me the information by email?

topics.title: Пошта й доставка
topics.goal: відправити посилку, обрати доставку та подати зрозумілу претензію

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Hello. What would you like to send?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'd like to send this parcel to Germany.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Would you like standard or tracked delivery?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How much is tracked delivery?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: It's twelve pounds and should arrive within four working days.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is insurance included?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Yes, up to fifty pounds.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Could I have the tracking number, please?

phrases.en: I'd like to send this parcel.
alternatives: I'd like to post this package.
I need to send this parcel abroad.

phrases.en: Do I need to complete a customs form?
Could I have the tracking number?

alternatives: My package still hasn't been delivered.
The parcel is overdue.

phrases.en: Could you check the tracking number?
How do I make a claim?
alternatives: How can I submit a claim?
What do I need to do to claim compensation?
